stages.title: S1 · rain
stages.question: how much rain, and when?
stages.oracle: nothing comes before rain: one gauge as a perfect forecast of the other (the floor)

parts.name: ICON, dead gauges from MRMS
parts.note: Same forecast as ICON, so the same score: S1's grade leaves out the dead-gauge days

stages.title: S2 · overflow model
stages.question: does the sewer overflow?
stages.oracle: rain from the gauges, dead-gauge days masked

parts.name: 9 terms with the south wind and the 3-hour peak

stages.title: S3 · beach split
stages.question: which zones does it reach?
stages.oracle: the true basin overflows, with the size predicted from rain (never the true size, which holds the answer)

stages.title: S4 · lingering table
stages.question: is the water over standard?
stages.oracle: the true zone overflows and the gauges' rain

parts.name: Rain curve or table, picked on S4
Rain curve or table, picked on the public number

stages.title: S5 · live correction rule
stages.question: does what was seen improve what comes after?
stages.oracle: a perfect feed: every filed overflow, on time (sibling zones are scored on real or degraded feeds only)

note.long: No correction is the baseline every other rule is measured against.
The lab-result rule moves the water-quality stage only; the public number never reads a lab result, so its change here is 0 by construction.
